sections.Profile:
Bird Man is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Sonic in 1978. The game features a hang-gliding theme, with artwork depicting a hang-glider soaring through the sky. Its playfield includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, four drop targets, two standup targets, two spinning targets, two kick-out holes, and two star rollovers.

- Manufacturer: Segasa
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Hang Gliding, Ocean, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s
